description: Client-side reconciliation output (one per component per role/package). Emitted by a Reconciliation Run and consumed by the invoice generator (P-191); queried by rec_run, not a child row. Carries the day-rate basis snapshot compared against the paired Payable Line by the BASIS-CONSISTENT guard.

fields.description: The stock Service Item this billable line maps to (the P-191 invoice line).
fields.label: Item

fields.description: Which billing component this line represents. eos is event-triggered only (a sponsorship-transfer event this period).
fields.label: Component
fields.options:
timesheet
overtime
levy
eos
gosi_fee
charge_fee

fields.description: Quantity in the component's unit (days, hours, or period).
fields.label: Quantity

fields.description: Day rate used (snapshot from the P-189 Rate Resolution; runtime).
fields.label: Day Rate Applied

fields.description: Day-rate basis snapshot (A1). Compared against the paired Payable Line by the BASIS-CONSISTENT guard; a mismatch halts the run.
fields.label: Day Rate Basis Applied

fields.description: Line amount (= day rate x billed days; computed at runtime; no VAT here).
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: Signed penalty adjustment on the client side (computed at runtime).
fields.label: Penalty Adjustment

fields.description: Provenance link to the P-189 Rate Resolution that priced this line; also the pairing key for the BASIS-CONSISTENT guard.
fields.label: Resolution Reference

name: Billable Line
